verdict.rationale: Morph is an API-first product. Its docs describe an OpenAI-compatible public API at https://api.morphllm.com/v1 plus a native Anthropic Messages endpoint at /v1/messages. One API key covers the chat models and the specialized tools, and documented job flows include creating, polling and classifying with Reflexes. A community user independently confirms driving it through the OpenAI-compatible endpoint, and an llms.txt index exists. Missing for 10: a machine-readable OpenAPI/Swagger spec, since all probed paths returned 404.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can drive the product through a documented public API

citations.quote: Point any OpenAI SDK at https://api.morphllm.com/v1. One API key covers the open-weight chat models and the specialized tools: Fast Apply for edits, WarpGrep for search, Compact for compression, Reflexes for classification.
Claude Code speaks the Anthropic Messages API, which Morph serves natively at `/v1/messages`.
Create a job, poll until it finishes, then classify text against it.
This uses an OpenAI-compatible endpoint, so got this working with my llm.datasette.io CLI tool
